scope: stationary matrix electron-boson SCBA plus explicit two-time Fourier export
implementation_change: Add a matrix-valued self_consistent_born_electron_boson solver with lesser/greater, Hilbert-reconstructed retarded self-energy, currents, and convergence metadata.
Add ScbaResult and scba_two_time_greens public APIs.
claim_boundary: The implementation is stationary SCBA; the explicit (t,t') result is a Fourier export of the stationary solution.
Time-dependent Kadanoff–Baym memory and interacting Kane–Mele transients remain open gates.
